subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack expose both `channel-info` and workspace-wide `channel-list`, and should both be controlled by the existing `channelInfo` capability or by separate permissions?
rationale: The plugin boundary and implementation path are clear, but channel enumeration has broader privacy, token-scope, and configuration implications than resolving one known channel ID.

options.title: Expose both under `channelInfo`
options.body: Add both read-only operations behind the existing capability, with explicit token, pagination, filtering, and authorization contracts to avoid another configuration setting.

options.title: Separate list permission
options.body: Expose `channel-info` under the existing capability but require an independent opt-in for potentially broader workspace enumeration.

options.title: Limit scope to channel lookup
options.body: Implement only `channel-info` for ID resolution and decline broad channel listing until a stronger product need and access policy are established.

recommendation.title: Expose both under `channelInfo`
recommendation.body: Add both read-only operations behind the existing capability, with explicit token, pagination, filtering, and authorization contracts to avoid another configuration setting.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged history covers the Slack action discovery, runtime, tests, and documentation surfaces involved in this policy choice.
